scope_comparison: Poisson electrostatic closure is not a subsystem of unrestricted Maxwell evolution for arbitrary data: setting magnetic B=0 requires curl E=0 persist, but Ampere E_t=-j generally creates curl when curl j differs from zero. Maxwell theorem therefore cannot be applied to arbitrary repulsive VP by choosing electrostatic initial fields. Nonrelativistic velocity and symmetric point-charge theorems also differ.
